title: Ancient DNA Extract Purification from Chunk Samples
author: Marcel Keller
materials: Wipe down outside surfaces of reagents/tips with DNA Exitus and place in the hood.
While tubes are spinning: Change gloves and label large volume columns (Roche) with Sample IDs on lids and sides (e.g. 12 on top and 12 on the side) and label Eppendorf 1.5 ml tubes:

When samples have concentrated, add 2.5 mL or at least 10x [extract volume] PB (binding) buffer to the Roche columns using the 5 ml pipette. Do not let this sit too long as the buffer starts to leak through the membrane quickly.

steps.title: Activate biosafety hood
steps.instruction: Turn the hood on full power and open the glass.

steps.title: Decontaminate surfaces
steps.instruction: Spray the hood and bench surfaces with DNA Exitus, let sit for 1 minute, then wipe down with paper towels.

steps.title: Prepare centrifuge rotor
steps.instruction: Check that the centrifuge rotor is the bucket, add 5 ml inserts, and wipe the rotor and inserts with DNA Exitus after removal and before reinsertion.

steps.title: Decontaminate sample tubes
steps.instruction: Remove parafilm from each sample tube, wipe with a small amount of DNA Exitus, then place the tubes in the centrifuge.

steps.title: Centrifuge pellets
steps.instruction: Spin down pellets at 4000 rpm, °C, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Label concentrator tubes
steps.instruction: Change gloves and label the concentrator lids and sides with sample ID numbers.

steps.title: Aliquot EB buffer
steps.instruction: In the hood, prepare EB buffer aliquots of 100 µL per sample in a 5 ml tube.

steps.title: Transfer samples to hood
steps.instruction: Move the centrifuged samples to the hood without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Add as much supernatant as possible to the labeled concentrators without disturbing the pellet; avoid collagen chunks that may interfere.

steps.title: Concentrate extracts
steps.instruction: Replace the 5 ml inserts with 50 ml inserts, wipe inserts with DNA Exitus, then centrifuge at 4000 rpm, °C, for 00:25:00 to 00:45:00 or until extracts are 250 µL.

steps.title: Prepare wash buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare PE (wash/ethanol) buffer by adding ethanol; aliquot PE buffer to a 50 ml tube as [# samples] × 1000 µL + 10%; aliquot PB buffer to a 50 ml tube as [# samples] × 2.4 mL + 10%; label the 50 ml waste tube, PB tube, PE tube, and the 5 ml EB tube.

steps.title: Add extract to PB buffer
steps.instruction: Add the concentrated extract to the PB buffer inside each Roche column, gently pipette to mix using 1000 µL long tips, changing tip for each sample.

steps.title: Spin column (PB binding)
steps.instruction: Spin Roche columns at 4000 rpm, °C, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Return columns to hood
steps.instruction: Change gloves and place the columns back in the hood.

steps.title: Wash column with PE
steps.instruction: Add 1000 µL of PE (wash/ethanol) buffer to each Roche column, changing tip each time.

steps.title: Spin column (PE wash)
steps.instruction: Spin at 4000 rpm, °C, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Return columns to hood again
steps.instruction: Change gloves and place the columns back in the hood.

steps.title: Prepare collection tube
steps.instruction: Using a clean 1.5 ml tube rack, take a collection tube from its bag without touching the inside of the bag or tube, and place it in the rack.

steps.title: Transfer column to collection tube
steps.instruction: Remove the inner column from the 50 ml Roche tube, pull the release tab and twist forward to free it, discard the funnel and plastic bits, avoid touching funnel sides (touching sides requires glove change), and place the column inside the clean collection tube.

steps.title: Label column/tube
steps.instruction: Close the lid on the column/tube and immediately label with the sample ID.

steps.title: Switch to 2 ml rotor
steps.instruction: Change gloves, replace the centrifuge rotor with the 2 ml rotor, and wipe the rotor and inserts with DNA Exitus after removal and before reinsertion.

steps.title: Dry membrane
steps.instruction: Spin the column plus collection tube at 13000 rpm, °C, for 1 minute to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Set heat block
steps.instruction: Turn on the heat block and set to 37 °C.

steps.title: Elute DNA into lo‑bind tube
steps.instruction: In the hood, remove the silica column from the collection tube and place it into a clean, labeled 1.5 ml lo‑bind Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add EB elution buffer
steps.instruction: Change gloves and add 100 µL of EB (elution) buffer to each sample, changing tip each time.

steps.title: Incubate elution
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples in the heat block at 37 °C for 00:10:00 (10 minutes).

steps.title: Spin eluate
steps.instruction: Spin at 13000 rpm, °C, for 2 minutes; arrange lids to prevent breakage.

steps.title: Finalize and store
steps.instruction: Back in the hood, discard the silica column, close the tube lid, wipe tubes with DNA Exitus, and wrap with parafilm if storage exceeds a few days before library prep; then store at -20 °C.
